verdict.rationale: The Public API lets you create, update, group, sort, and filter views at any level of the ClickUp hierarchy (clickup-docs-33). That gives programmatic control over native view configurations, which only glancingly covers the story. There is no evidence of a UI extension SDK for building custom-rendered views, and none for creating custom dashboard widgets that embed natively. Figma embeds (clickup-intdir-5) are content embedding, not designer-built extensions. Missing for 10: custom UI/app extension framework, custom dashboard widget API, native-look component/design system for extensions, hands-on corroboration.
